from dataclasses import dataclass

from .matcher import matches


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PublicRoute:
    pattern: str
    # When False, wildcards may not cross "/" so each wildcard covers exactly one path segment.
    span_segments: bool = True

    def matches(self, path: str) -> bool:
        # Wildcards consumed no separators iff the path has as many "/" as the pattern.
        if not self.span_segments and path.count("/") != self.pattern.count("/"):
            return False
        return matches(path, self.pattern)


DEFAULT_ROUTES = (PublicRoute("/teams/*/badge.png", span_segments=False),)
EOF

        "/teams/west/badge.png": b"PNG",

def test_host_routes_still_span_segments():

    assert service.fetch("/partners/acme/logos/logo.png") == (200, b"logo")
